# W09 v5 / CM40 Source proposal

This package prepares Source only. Main, Canon370/OW174/CM39, existing receipts, actual formal capture index, and original session audit are unchanged. No Go, Native, dispatcher, model, SQLite, credential, signing, or product operation was run. The 46 preserved v4 controls and 57 added controls are pure Source checks; their role captures and checkpoint files exist only under temporary synthetic repositories inside this package and have been removed. They grant no actual role or formal authority.

## Proposed files and route registration

Root may consider `candidate-root/execution/v2.4/formal_profile_w09.py` and `candidate-root/execution/v2.4/commands.json` only after a non-author Source review and a new bounded Root scope/adoption procedure. This package supplies neither an activation command nor Canon mutation authority. The Profile is loaded only from the existing fixed Main path after adoption. Receipt-provided code remains prohibited. The full formal index is byte-identical, including its 51719-byte CRLF W04/W07 prefix. All original W09 six routes, eight formal assertions, dependencies, global C19/A06 files, Native raw graph, owned inventory, clocks, capture index, original Verifier delivery, and CAS checks remain mandatory.

CM40 is a proposal with `updated_at=PENDING_ROOT_ACTUAL_ISSUANCE`. Root must issue the actual metadata, retain `updated_by=codex:/root`, and register exactly the proposed semantic command delta. `test.retrieval` gains W09-G01, W09-G02, and A06 selectors. `test.security` gains task W09/case A06 and uses the existing fixed Python W09 router; its old W17 task/check selectors remain, and `tool_env.RESEARCHOS_GO=go` supplies the locked Go tool for the router's real W17 security fallback. Its Native proof env allowlist is the existing retrieval allowlist, not arbitrary process environment. Unrelated command entries and all original metadata fields remain semantically identical. Existing registry files and historical receipts are preserved.

The commands proposal does not claim these four newly registered routes executed. Root must issue bounded scopes, current owner/worker leases and actual invocation receipts for them, then obtain independent mode and full formal review. Missing resources block only the affected route.

## Exactly two C19 historical receipts

The only permitted old-registry path is the already existing physical CM39 archive at `execution/v2.4/receipts/W09/W09-99/checkpoint_r369_native_source_root/cp369-c19-20261009/historical.cp369.commands.json`, SHA `28b4ba18ce2ab3ce03287651e311ae2bd36293b53fd8c298e5bf1f231f56d027`, bytes 68968. No author-selected archive is accepted.

The only permitted old receipts are research fixture invocation `83d5069c-d717-416b-9a60-e228aa5e7024`, SHA `bf2ac8d0ef42db4662d1bfa553a749ed9fc50b0e79421825692a2c98f7281e02`, bytes 2367, and retrieval invocation `51bd0940-8cb7-4705-9bf6-60ffcb916077`, SHA `f1a1f6b15629bcfdf0a7234ba0716fd9a81487cb51975b0015ccb2d509284e3a`, bytes 2331. Both must retain exact empty check/C19 case/task W09 selectors and all ordinary dispatcher exit, raw stdout/stderr, assertion, argv, cwd, executable, toolchain, dispatcher and current Source checks. The historical exception is limited to the registered command hash and, if present, the logical `execution/v2.4/commands.json` input-version ref. That input resolves to the exact physical archive; other input-version refs must resolve to current pinned files.

CM39-to-CM40 must equal the exact four-route proposal and preserve every selected C19 entry except additive selectors. CM41 or unrelated command changes are rejected until independently reviewed; this is not general historical compatibility. A receipt's unchanged old lease is checked against its actual invocation interval, not rewritten as a current lease. The two existing independently qualified C19 components remain formal count zero until the complete current W09 contract is met.

## Required actual role authority, not supplied here

Outer W09 context/review/issuance schema names stay v1 so the unchanged index can discover them. A context must additionally contain `role_policy={schema:"researchos.w09.execution-role-policy.v1",registry_ref:{path,sha256,bytes}}`. Root must first register the same exact three-key ref in current `checkpoint.work_in_progress.w09_execution_role_registry_ref`. The fixed path is `execution/v2.4/root_delivery_captures/W09/W09-99/execution-roles.json`. Its two-key path/hash ref must also be present in the context's current version-vector input files. These actual files and Canon slot are currently unavailable; this package does not create them.

The role registry schema is `researchos.w09.execution-role-registry.v1`, exact fields `schema,writer_actor,run_id,roles,provenance,route_execution_refs`. Writer is Root; roles are `source_authors` (nonempty distinct actor list), `executor`, `assembler`, `verifier`, `root_observer`. Native mode `producer_id`, original Root Scope and owner `selected_worker_id` must bind the same actual executor. Root remains `codex:/root` for the already executed Native C19 work. Source authors are never relabeled as executors. Root may also be the evidence assembler and observer. The Verifier must differ from every Source author, actual executor, assembler and observer.

Every role has an exact, unique provenance record `role,actor_id,origin_kind,raw_ref,actual_audit_ref`. Source author and Root observer origins are real Root scope registrations (`source_actor` and `issued_by`). Executor/Verifier origins are independently qualified actual mode decisions (`producer_id` and `reviewer_id`). Assembly origin is a real Root owner document `selected_worker_id`, whose pinned Root Scope has slice `W09_FULL_FORMAL_ASSEMBLY`, ACTIVE owner/lease and expiry at least the context creation time. Root must supply this missing assembly Scope and owner; the earlier C19 component owner is not silently promoted to full assembly authority.

Each role's `actual_audit_ref` is an exact public three-key ref under the W09 Source receipt boundary. Audit schema is `researchos.w09.actual-role-audit.v1`, fields `schema,actor_id,role,Root_thread_id,source_audit_path,source_line_offsets,original_line_sha256,source_prefix_size_observed,original_capture_ref,binding_sha256`. Root captures only finite actual public audit records: session header and the actual paired Root tool call/output, or session header and the adjacent peer communication/message. The original bytes, selected source offsets, hashes and source prefix bounds must match the fixed current Root session audit. The public binding hash must name the role's actual origin artifact or its actual linked Source/review/report artifact and appear in the original call/delivery. Source-authored actor strings, invented captures, rewritten original records, unknown roles or fake origins do not authorize a role. The audit file is read only at these bounded ranges and those ranges join the final CAS snapshot.

`route_execution_refs` contains all six exact route tuples, each with exact `scope_ref` and `owner_ref` three-key public refs. Root Scope must authorize the command, owner scope pin must name that same physical Scope, selected worker must be the actual Native producer, owner must be ACTIVE, and expiry must cover the original receipt's end time. Root must provide actual route registrations and leases for the four new routes; this Source package provides none.

## Independent formal delivery and issuer

Review has `executor_id` equal to the actual executor, `reviewer_id` equal to the registered independent Verifier, and `issuer_id` equal to that Verifier. Root-observed issuance has `actor=observer_id=codex:/root`, the same executor/reviewer, and `issuer_id` still equal to the Verifier. Owner executor/verifier must match. These additions explicitly distinguish issuer from observer; Root is not the AcceptanceReceipt issuer.

The existing `_capture_registry` and `_root_original` bodies are unchanged. Root's fixed Canon-pinned formal capture index remains mandatory, and the actual original plaintext delivery must be authored by the registered Verifier and received by `/root`, with exact review/context hashes, message id, times, offsets and original-byte hashes. Root's own final plaintext cannot stand in for that peer delivery. Role audit records are not formal delivery records and do not grant AcceptanceReceipt authority. Root must wait for the independent Verifier's actual full formal result before capturing or registering any formal delivery.

Frozen Goal08 lines 104 and 140 require executor/Verifier independence and forbid executor self-issuance. The W09 parent card also requires an independent Verifier. They do not require Root observer to differ from executor. W04/W07 retain their existing stronger three-actor code rules without modification. If an additional applicable frozen contract establishes a conflicting identity constraint, block only that role-reuse branch and retain its exact excerpt; never rewrite actual actors.

## Root continuation prerequisites

Required sequence is non-author Source review, explicit actual Root Source/adoption Scope, current guarded Source/toolchain/registry pins, Root-issued actual role registrations/audit proofs and route leases, four newly registered bounded invocations, independent mode qualification, then full independent W09 review and original peer formal delivery. Existing C19 reuse is permitted only after those current prerequisites are verified by Root. All formal/parent acceptance is NOTRUN in this package. All 22 parents and 42 formal cases remain subject to the original acceptance rules. Original failures 1018 and 1020 are retained and do not reset any historical counter.
